entries.title: Psalms 103:1
segments:
. A Psalm of joyous praise, in which the writer rises from a thankful acknowledgment of personal blessings to a lively celebration of God's gracious attributes, as not only intrinsically worthy of praise, but as specially suited to man's frailty. He concludes by invoking all creatures to unite in his song. 
 
    1. Bless, &c.--when God is the object, praise. 
 
    my soul--myself (

), with allusion to the act, as one of intelligence. 
 
    all ... within me-- (

entries.title: Psalms 103:2
segments: 2. forget not all--not any, none of His benefits.

entries.title: Psalms 103:4
segments:

    destruction--literally, "pit of corruption" (

entries.title: Psalms 103:5
segments: 5. By God's provision, the saint retains a youthful vigor like the eagles (

entries.title: Psalms 103:6
segments: 6. Literally, "righteousness and judgments," denoting various acts of God's government.

entries.title: Psalms 103:8
segments: 8-10. God's benevolence implies no merit. He shows it to sinners, who also are chastened for a time (
